title: Alert Provider
description: Turns each firing of an observability Alert into an Incident with an incident-agent root-cause analysis and its how-to-fix scripts.

global.title: Global values (injected by the Krateo composition engine)
global.description: Context keys the composition-dynamic-controller injects when this chart installs as a component (plumbing InjectGlobalValues), plus the helm-standard imageRegistry override.

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Container image tag. Empty defaults to the chart appVersion (= the release tag), so chart and image move together.

imagePullSecrets.title: Image pull secrets
imagePullSecrets.description: Pull credentials for the private image, set on the krateo-alert-provider ServiceAccount (the Deployment and the hyperdx-key-bootstrap Job). The Krateo installer wires it from registryAuth.

autopilotA2aUrl.title: RCA agent A2A URL
autopilotA2aUrl.description: A2A endpoint of the agent the webhook calls for root-cause analysis. Defaults to the in-cluster kagent A2A Service `http://incident-agent.krateo-system.svc:8080/` (kagent names the Service after the Agent's metadata.name).

compareModelConfig.title: Comparison ModelConfig
compareModelConfig.description: kagent ModelConfig, in the release namespace, whose model judges which open incident of a firing alert covers the alert's current records: one chat-completions call per firing, with no agent. Provider OpenAI (its baseUrl; with apiKeyPassthrough the key is the service JWT) or Gemini. A firing that no open incident covers opens a new incident.

maxCompareCandidates.title: Comparison candidates
maxCompareCandidates.description: How many of an alert's newest open, analyzed incidents one comparison weighs. An older one can still take a firing as unanalyzed, never through the comparison. Each adds up to about 5,500 characters to the prompt.

incidentCoverWindow.title: Incident cover window
incidentCoverWindow.description: Go duration (e.g. 90m, 24h) an open, analyzed incident keeps covering its alert's firings after it opened or last covered one (observability.krateo.io/last-covered-at). Past it the incident is stale: no comparison weighs it, so a firing it would have covered opens a new incident with a fresh RCA, which names it in observability.krateo.io/supersedes-stale. "0" disables it.

failedAnalysisHold.title: Failed-RCA hold (s)
failedAnalysisHold.description: Seconds an incident whose RCA failed keeps taking its alert's firings, counted from the failure. Past it, a firing nothing else covers opens a new incident with a fresh RCA; the failed one stays Open until a person closes it or asks for a new analysis.

maxConcurrentAnalyses.title: Concurrent RCAs
maxConcurrentAnalyses.description: How many RCAs run at once; more wait, Analyzing, for a free slot. One RCA reads up to ~1M input tokens a minute, so alerts that fire together would otherwise exhaust the model's per-minute quota and fail every RCA at once.

analysisRetries.title: RCA retries
analysisRetries.description: How many more times an RCA that failed transiently runs: the call failed (a timeout, a 5xx, a cut stream), the answer was empty, or it was only the model's error. The incident stays Analyzing meanwhile.

analysisRetryDelay.title: RCA retry delay (s)
analysisRetryDelay.description: Seconds before the first RCA retry; each next retry waits twice as long.

authnUrl.title: authn base URL (intra-service auth)
authnUrl.description: Base URL of the authn service. When set, the handler exchanges its projected ServiceAccount token (audience "authn") at `<authnUrl>/serviceaccount/login` for a Krateo JWT and presents it on the A2A calls, so the agentgateway authenticates them and incident-agent can reach its gated MCP tools; a `serviceaccount.authn.krateo.io` ServiceAccount mapping CR is also rendered. Requires authn's serviceaccount strategy. Empty (default) disables it — the A2A call is unauthenticated (safe on older clusters with no gateway). Enable in-cluster with `http://authn.krateo-system.svc`.

hyperdxApiUrl.title: HyperDX API URL
hyperdxApiUrl.description: HyperDX v2 external API the reconciler pushes Alert CRs to (Bearer auth). Defaults to the krateo-clickstack-api Service.

reconcileInterval.title: Reconcile interval (s)
reconcileInterval.description: How often (seconds) the reconciler pushes Alert CRs to HyperDX and mirrors their state. Each pass that finds an alert ALERT is one firing of it.

defaultAlerts.title: Default alerts
defaultAlerts.description: Alert CRs the reconciler seeds into its namespace on start when absent (rendered to DEFAULT_ALERTS_JSON). Empty by default: the platform default alerts ship in krateo-observability. Seeding never updates or deletes an Alert.

threshold.description: A row count. Typed integer, not number: crdgen types number as a string in the generated CRD.

otel.title: OpenTelemetry tracing
otel.description: Exports the provider's spans over OTLP/HTTP to the node-local collector agent at http://$(HOST_IP):4318. Off by default: nothing renders and no tracer is registered. Only the Deployment gets the variables; the bootstrap Job's pod template is immutable within a release.

enabled.title: Tracing enabled
enabled.description: Sets OTEL_ENABLED, OTEL_TRACING_ENABLED, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER, OTEL_SERVICE_NAME and SERVICE_VERSION on the Deployment.

tracesSampler.title: Traces sampler
tracesSampler.description: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER, read by the OpenTelemetry SDK. parentbased_always_on keeps every root span and follows an inbound parent's decision otherwise.
